title: Đề luyện Nói VSTEP — Review HVNH HN 18/8/2026

questions.content:
speaking — Part 1

In this first part, I'd like to ask you some questions about yourself. Let's talk about reading books, and then about your neighbourhood.

speaking — Part 2

Situation: You have been asked to organise a special event for a group of young children. You are considering the following options: 1. Holding a small music concert for them 2. Letting them play games together 3. Letting them cook simple dishes themselves Which one would you choose? Why?

speaking — Part 3

Topic: Losing a job can change a person's life, and the reasons are not always outside their control. Talk about the main reasons why people lose their jobs and how such situations can be avoided. Ideas: - A bad attitude at work - Unhealthy competition between colleagues - A lack of necessary skills - Your own idea Further questions: 1. Which of these reasons do you think is the most common? Why? 2. Should it be the worker or the company that helps an employee who is about to lose their job? 3. What should a person do immediately after losing their job?
